name: automorphism_group (generating set of Aut(G) via the shared I-R engine)

benchmarks.note: Same engine as canonical_permutation (ALGO-ISO-003) and count_automorphisms (ALGO-ISO-004); the engine collects all leaf automorphisms then greedily selects a generating subset, so cost tracks the symmetric C_n I-R tree — figures match the canonicalization baseline within noise
